negative_findings.description: No LinkedIn company page could be surfaced for Addiko Bank AD Podgorica, Ziraat Bank Montenegro AD Podgorica or Zapad banka AD Podgorica via external search; only individual employee profiles appeared (Addiko surfaced solely through an executive mention).
negative_findings.result_summary: Employee-profile-only visibility for at least three licensed ME banks.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of the licensed-bank universe via company pages is incomplete; monitoring for these actors must fall back to individual profiles or non-LinkedIn sources.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn's content/people search — the mechanism that actually surfaces 'new role' announcements — is unreachable without an authenticated session, and external search engines index those posts only sparsely. Local-language phrase queries ('nova uloga', 'sa zadovoljstvom objavljujem') returned almost no genuine ME banking announcement posts through an external engine.
negative_findings.result_summary: The highest-value signal in this cell is only reachable from inside an authenticated LinkedIn session.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that assumes crawlable LinkedIn post search will fail; the cell requires an analyst account and manual saved searches.

negative_findings.description: No LinkedIn school/alumni page was surfaced for Ekonomski fakultet Podgorica (Univerzitet Crne Gore); only Facebook, X and Instagram presences appeared. LinkedIn's Alumni tool is itself login-gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Alumni-based discovery of banking staff could not be established from outside LinkedIn.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The alumni route — a strong way to enumerate a small market's banking cohort — remains unvalidated and needs an authenticated check.

negative_findings.description: Beyond Payten/ASEE, no LinkedIn company page for a Montenegro-licensed non-bank payment institution was confirmed; the ME payments startups named by Tracxn (PencePay, XCHPay.me, LocalPay, Sharej, 4On) were not individually verified as having LinkedIn pages in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSP-side LinkedIn coverage is thin and unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sector scope is 'both' (banking and payments); the payments half of this cell is materially weaker than the banking half.

negative_findings.description: Several actors have more than one LinkedIn slug (Hipotekarna Banka: /hipotekarna-banka and /hipotekarna-banka-official-page-; CBCG: /centralna-banka-crne-gore and /central-bank-of-montenegro).
negative_findings.result_summary: Duplicate/legacy company pages exist per actor.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring only one slug risks missing posts; deduplication rules are needed in the source registry.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's core signal (individual 'new role' posts, People tabs, Alumni tool, job-post history) requires a logged-in LinkedIn session, which this pass did not have.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision an analyst LinkedIn account with saved searches for ME bank/PSP names plus sr/en role-change phrases; define a manual, ToS-compliant weekly review cadence rather than any crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn presences unmapped for Addiko Bank Podgorica, Ziraat Bank Montenegro, Zapad banka, and for non-bank payment institutions licensed by CBCG.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the CBCG register of banks and of payment institutions, then run one authenticated LinkedIn company search per registered name; record 'no page' explicitly where true.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin/Serbian role-change phrasing was used in queries but produced few genuine hits externally, so the local-language phrase list is untested against real post volume.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inside an authenticated session, test and rank phrases: 'nova uloga', 'novi izazov', 'pridružio/la sam se timu', 'sa zadovoljstvom objavljujem', 'imenovan/a za', 'direktor sektora', 'izvršni direktor', 'rukovodilac', 'šef službe', 'unapređenje'; keep those with real yield.

coverage_gaps.description: People aggregators (ZoomInfo, SignalHire, EMIS) carry stale and paywalled role data and cannot by themselves date a leadership move.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use aggregators only for cross-checking; date every leadership move from a primary post, a company announcement, or a CBCG/registry filing.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is entirely personal-data-heavy and governed by platform ToS plus GDPR-equivalent Montenegrin data-protection rules.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a minimisation policy before collection starts: store employer, role title, date and public URL only; never contact details; no automated scraping of LinkedIn or aggregators.

brief: Montenegro's banking sector is small enough that essentially every licensed bank has a LinkedIn company page — CKB, NLB, Hipotekarna, Erste, Lovćen, Adriatic, Universal Capital, Prva banka and the CBCG regulator were all located — and those pages are, for several of them, richer than their own websites for hiring and org-unit signals. The decisive signal in this cell, however, is individual: 'new role' posts and People/Alumni tabs, all of which sit behind LinkedIn's auth wall and are only sparsely indexed by external engines, so the cell must be worked manually from an analyst account rather than crawled. Payments-side coverage is materially thinner than banking: only Payten/ASEE (with a real Podgorica entity) is confirmed, while local PSPs and fintechs are known so far only as names from a startup directory. People aggregators (ZoomInfo, SignalHire, EMIS) work as stale cross-checks on titles but never as the dating source for a move, and the whole cell requires an explicit personal-data minimisation policy before collection begins.
